method.sampling: 5 warmup pages, then 30 measured pages per browser and period; 4 scenarios on each page
method.twoFrame: click capture to second requestAnimationFrame (legacy metric)
method.dom: first dialog textarea with URL observed by MutationObserver
method.ready: focus reached, finite dialog animations finished, then two requestAnimationFrames; includes normal transition time
method.heartbeat: 20ms interval; max observed gap overlapping the ready window
method.longTask: Chromium Long Task API; null means unsupported, not zero blocking
method.updates: threshold native change or hash assignment to the second frame after DOM update, measured before opening
method.note: Tracing is disabled during these statistical runs. JavaScript engine/font/browser caches are warmed by separate pages; initial means the first opening on each fresh page.
